name: Fig Tree
overview: The fig tree in Scripture often serves as a powerful figurative and allegorical symbol. In Jeremiah's parable, good and bad figs represent the distinction between those pleasing and displeasing to God, illustrating spiritual fruitfulness and judgment. Jesus uses the fig tree in parables to signify readiness and the importance of bearing fruit, as seen in the vineyard owner seeking fruit from a barren fig tree and the tender branch signaling the coming of summer. These passages emphasize the call to spiritual vigilance and the consequences of unfruitfulness.
